title: genoa receipt
description: v1 attestation envelope emitted by `genoa build`. Every image ships with a co-located receipt. Consumers: fleet-eval, verify subcommand, any downstream pipeline. 1.1.0 (additive): microvm boot/state_disks/launch sections, correlation, and the fields genoa build already emits (build.profile, hashes.manifest_path, signing.action, genoa-* builder types, hash sentinels).

schema_version.description: Receipt schema version. Consumers must reject receipts with unknown versions.

receipt_id.description: UUIDv4 uniquely identifying this receipt. Stable across re-verifications.

built_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the build completed.

output_path.description: Absolute path to the image file on the build host at build time.

size_bytes.description: Actual byte size of the image file on disk.

provisioned_mb.description: Provisioned image size in MiB (virtual disk size).

host.description: Hostname of the machine that ran the build.

builder_type.description: Build environment type. 'dry-run' when no actual build occurred.

os_version.description: OS version on the build host. Example: 'FreeBSD 15.0-RELEASE'.

arch.description: CPU architecture of the build host. Example: 'aarch64'.

genoa_version.description: Version of the genoa CLI that produced this receipt.

dry_run.description: If true, no image was actually produced; receipt describes the planned build.

build_commands.description: Ordered list of commands that were (or would be) executed. Present in both real and dry-run receipts.

would_run.description: True in dry-run mode: command would be executed but was not.

profile.description: Build profile that produced the artifact.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the fetched agent binary before installation.

image_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the output artifact (disk image, or the kernel ELF for profile=microvm). 'PLACEHOLDER_DRY_RUN' when not computed; 'HASH_COMPUTATION_FAILED' when hashing was attempted and failed.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the input manifest TOML file as-read.

kernel_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the deployed kernel config file, if applicable.

release_conf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the release conf (smolbsd-qemu.conf) injected into the build.

manifest_path.description: Path of the manifest as passed to genoa build.

signing.description: Signing information. Present only when signing.tool != 'none'.

placeholder.description: If true, signing was not actually performed (stub mode). Never trust a placeholder signature.

public_key_file.description: Public key path recorded for verification.

key_file.description: Secret key path used (dry-run plan only).

claims.description: Verifiable claims about the image. Each claim can be checked by fleet-eval.

claim.description: Human-readable statement of what is asserted.

executor.description: Runtime to use when evaluating the probe. 'nu' = Nushell (nu -c), 'sh' = POSIX shell (sh -c).

probe.description: Command to verify the claim. Evaluate with the declared executor.

status.description: Verification status at receipt-emit time. 'unverified'/'asserted' for dry-run or unverified claims.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this claim was verified, if status=verified.

published.description: Populated by `genoa run` after a successful publish step. Absent if image was not published.

url.description: Public URL where the image was uploaded (e.g. an R2 or S3 object URL).

published_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the publish completed.

correlation.description: Immutable identity tuple for joining this artifact to a run (C2: identity, content hash and ordering stay distinct). genoa records the logical run id it was given and content hashes; it never mints an ordering/version counter — filesystem-native versions (HAMMER TID, LFS checkpoint) belong to the filesystem.

run_id.description: Logical run identity from `genoa build --run-id` (e.g. a BOP card/run id); null when not supplied.

boot.description: profile=microvm: direct-kernel boot contract and boot-artifact identity.

root_disk.description: False: the boot artifact needs no root disk (root embedded in the ELF or supplied as an immutable initrd).

state_disks.description: profile=microvm: writable state volumes, each hashed independently of the boot artifact. sha256 is null when the disk was not built (action requires-host/failed) — a disk that was not built is never given a hash.

uuid.description: Logical volume identity (declared in the manifest or generated at build time); not a content hash and not an ordering counter.

launch.description: profile=microvm: local VMM launch plans. genoa never starts the VMM.

qemu_microvm.description: argv for qemu-system-* -M microvm (accelerator chosen by the runner).
